items.title: Nice Touch Launches V2 of Its AI Edit Assistant for Pro Editors
items.excerpt: Nice Touch has launched Version 2 of its app of the same name, an AI edit assistant for professional video post teams. V2 is a full rebuild shaped by more than 300 conversations with editors, producers, production supervisors and studio owners. It is available now.  Nice Touch analyzes a project’s footage,
items.rationale: Shipping-today tool release for post teams — a full rebuild informed by 300+ editor interviews, so it changes how an assistant editor preps footage tomorrow.

items.title: If You Prompt a Movie or Song Into Existence With AI, You Shouldn’t Be Able to Profit From It
items.excerpt: "Politicians should back legislation to prevent prompted generative AI outputs from being copyrighted across film, TV and music. The foundation of human creativity is at stake," writes the Motion Picture Sound Editors president.
items.rationale: The Motion Picture Sound Editors president calls for legislation denying copyright to purely prompted output — the sharpest craft-guild position yet on who owns AI work.

items.title: Francesco Carrozzini on His Venice AI Doc ‘Be Brave’ and Why ‘The Human Has to Come First’ (EXCLUSIVE)
items.excerpt: Francesco Carrozzini on his Venice-bound artificial intelligence film 'Be Brave'
items.rationale: A Venice-premiering documentary built around AI, with its director laying out a human-first working method — festival-level proof of where the argument is landing.

items.title: 'Junkyard King' Creator Henry Daubrez Introduces Us to His Wild Animated World
items.excerpt: 'Junkyard King' creator and Odd Kid studio founder Henry Daubrez tells us how a practical approach to AI can fuel a creator-driven show.
items.rationale: A working showrunner walks through the practical AI setup behind a creator-driven animated series — concrete method rather than manifesto.

items.title: Lawsuit Over AI Character Tung Tung Sahur Has Companies Bickering; Hearing Set
items.excerpt: Hollywood's future could take shape in a a legal fight full of Italian Brainrot AI slop, trademark claims, & certain Tung Tung Sahur, with guest appearances by Roblox and Fortnite
items.rationale: First real courtroom test of who owns a viral AI-born character, with a hearing set — the trademark logic here will shape IP claims on generated characters.
